summary: Full test pass of the new 'Zahlung per Überweisung' bank-transfer flow (backend API + admin + scheduler + frontend guest/admin UI). 12/12 pytest cases passed. All key data-testids present on both /booking/h1 and /booking/transfer/:id and /admin/bookings. All acceptance criteria met.

issues: Language toggle text shows the CURRENT language ('DE') rather than the target language ('EN'). Could confuse guests; consider showing the *target* language on the toggle. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (~2941 lines). Bank-transfer section is well isolated but the file overall would benefit from splitting into modules (payments, admin, bookings, scheduler) for maintainability.

In _reserve_for_transfer the bank-transfer-instructions email is fired via asyncio.create_task (fire-and-forget) so the API returns fast (good), but in process_bank_transfers the reminder/expired emails are awaited sequentially with ~9s SMTP timeouts per booking — with many transfer_pending bookings the scheduler run can take a long time. Consider gathering them concurrently or using asyncio.create_task.
No unit test coverage for currency/deposit rounding edge cases (fractional nights not possible but different room_types would help).
test_credentials: admin: info@travel-events.de / admin123 (from problem statement, confirmed working via POST /api/admin/login -> 200)
seed_data_creation: Created ~19 TEST_* bookings during tests (guest booking, converted bookings, scheduler bookings). Cleaned up at end via mongo (bookings + payment_events + email_logs + payment_transactions). Hotel inventory restored to single=5, double=3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bank-transfer feature fully functional. Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_bank_transfer.py. Scheduler test (test_scheduler_reminder_and_expire) needs subprocess timeout >=180s because SMTP fails after ~9s per email and the test triggers reminder + expired emails. Local SMTP always fails - email_logs rows are still created with status='failed' - that is expected. Test data prefix used: 'TEST_' and booking numbers HBH-TEST-* / HBH-SCHED-*.

tests: POST /api/bookings/bank-transfer happy path -> status transfer_pending, method bank_transfer, deposit_amount=75, transfer_due_date ~+7d, inventory decremented, payment_events 'transfer_reserved' logged, email_logs 'bank_transfer_instructions' created with bcc info@travel-events.de (status=failed as expected)

POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/transfer-received deposit -> status deposit_paid, payment_transactions{payment_method:bank_transfer, payment_type:deposit, amount:75, status:completed}; repeat -> 400; payment_type:'other' -> 400; then remaining amount 225 -> fully_paid + second transaction
POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/convert-to-transfer send_email:false on abandoned -> 200 transfer_pending, inventory decremented, NO new email log; second call -> 400; deposit_paid -> 400
PUT /api/admin/bookings/{id}/status with status=transfer_pending and status=expired -> 200 (valid_statuses extended)
process_bank_transfers: reserved_at now-6d -> reminder email log created; reserved_at now-11d -> status expired, inventory +1, 'transfer_expired' event and email log; reserved_at now-2d -> untouched
